newsitem.title: FRANCE: More French forwarders set to join Traxon.
newsitem.headline: More French forwarders set to join Traxon.

text.p: A further three France-based airfreight forwarders are set to join airfreight information system, Traxon, a Traxon official told Reuters.
"By the end of March 1997, Thyssen Haniel, Partnair and Jet Air Service (JAS) should have their CDG offices linked to Traxon," the official said.

French forwarders, Calberson and Setavion, which belong the same freight transport group, Geodis, linked the whole of its network, which represents a total of 15 offices, to Traxon, effective January 1, the official added.

"The total number of French agents linked to Traxon currently stands at 29, representing 116 offices. Along with our airline participants, around 65 percent of the French air cargo sector is now linked to Traxon."

Traxon's services include the provision of information on flights schedules, booking of shipments and tracing and tracking of shipments, reservation and transmission of air waybill information to airlines.

The full list of Traxon's airline participants worldwide reads: Air Canada, Air France, British Airways Plc, Cargolux, Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd, Emirates, Finnair, Japan Airlines, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV, Korean Airlines Ltd, Deutsche Lufthansa AG, Martinair, Royal Air Maroc, SAS, Singapore Airlines and Swissair.
1,850 agents worldwide are linked to Traxon, covering a network of approximately 4,500 offices. Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
